_comment: Which connected Chrome belongs to which Mac. Written by the chrome-pick skill.
Edit THIS file (~/Developer/claude-kit/chrome-browsers.json), never the installed copy,
then run kit-update so the other machines learn it too.
deviceId survives restarts but changes when the extension is reinstalled or re-authenticated,
so treat an entry as a recommendation and confirm it with one probe round before acting.

browsers.signedInTo: work — jira.wsgc.com, github.wsgc.com, both Slack workspaces
browsers.note: Appeared only after the extension was signed in again on 2026-08-17; the three deviceIds present before that (2a3a86cf…, 777dafa0…, c6e75d27…) are other Macs and all falsely reported isLocal:true.

Named 'Luft-Mac' by the user in the switch_browser dialog on 2026-08-17; the name did not stick in list_connected_browsers, which is why this file exists.
